attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own post, said in his own voice.

semantics.note: Accurately restates an unhedged present-tense judgement about Claude Code.

contract.note: The plain reading (substantial, recurring limitations, not one rare defect) is the ordinary sense of 'not even close' to perfect. Using March 2026, the last full month before the post, is a reasonable window for an undated observation.

evidence.note: Anthropic's postmortem admits a bug shipped March 26 that caused forgetfulness, repetition and odd tool choices. It is a company disclosure, but an admission against its own interest. Published April 23, before the evaluation date.
A dated firsthand GitHub log analysis shows repeated workflow violations on many March days. Its proposed cause is not established, but it corroborates recurring practical failures.

reviews.rationale: Two independent sources document recurring, material Claude Code failures in March 2026: a vendor-acknowledged defect and a firsthand log analysis. That meets the support condition and goes beyond a single anecdote. The packet has no evidence of consistently near-perfect operation.

attribution.note: Marcus's own description of the leaked source in his own post.

semantics.note: Keeps the counts and the characterisation. Leaving out the 'godfathers would recognise' line as rhetoric is appropriate.

contract.note: How branch points and nesting are counted, what 'kernel' refers to, and what counts as 'classical symbolic AI' all go undefined by the speaker. The contract's test for 'symbolic' may be stricter than Marcus's own broad usage, which treats calling code as symbolic AI.

evidence.note: A firsthand inspection on March 31 reports a 3,167-line function with 12 levels of nesting in print.ts. This corroborates the nesting figure only; it gives no 486 count and no counting method.
An April 2026 architecture preprint describes a simple model-and-tool loop. It gives no branch count and does not address the symbolic-AI classification.

reviews.rationale: Only the 12-level nesting figure is corroborated, and without a reproducible method. The packet has no authenticated reproduction of the 486 branch points, and nothing settles whether the code is substantive symbolic AI or ordinary orchestration. The evidence does not settle the claim.

attribution.note: Marcus's own causal assertion in his own post.

semantics.note: 'Superiority' is a fair rendering of 'better'. The speaker gives no comparator or measure.

contract.note: The comparator, the meaning of 'scaling' and the symbolic components are unstated. The contract supplies a reasonable reading and flags these ambiguities rather than resolving them silently.

evidence.note: A September 2026 harness comparison holds the model fixed but uses later models and never varies scale. It cannot explain the advantage of the April product.

reviews.rationale: No evidence varies the symbolic components and model scale independently for the product as of April 2026. The only item is later context that does not isolate either cause, so the causal claim is unsettled.
